On 4.12.2025, this case was listed for today for final argument as this appeal is of the year 2005.
2. Arguments of learned counsel for the parties are heard.
Perused the record very minutely.

3 . The State has filed this Criminal Appeal against the acquittal of respondents herein by order dated 6.12.2004 by the Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate/Special Magistrate, C.B.I/Economic Offences, Jabalpur in Special Case No. 3/2003 - State of Madhya Pradesh through Economic Offence Wing Bhopal v. Gulam Hussan and another.

4. After perusal of the record and looking to the fact that in NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-JBP:63446 2 CRA-1735-2005 the case of acquittal a double presumption arises in favour of the accused and if two views are possible, the view which favours the accused should be taken.

This Court finds that as narrated in the impugned judgment, prosecution has failed to produce any witness who can verify that he was duped on the basis of false advertisement and handed over some money for winning the lottery for motorcycle.
It is not the evidence collected during investigation which is substantive evidence, but what oral and documentary evidence are produced would be material.

During investigation no document was seized and sent for hand-writing expert to say that appellant made some document like receipt etc. or signed any document if any publication was made in paper or pamphlet then there is no evidence as to in which printing press and by whom it was published.
5. As seen from F.I.R. Ex. P-21 recorded by Inspector B.D. Dubey of E.O.W. It is mentioned therein that information has been received from reliable sources.
Therefore, it would indicate that no person made complaint to the Economic Offence Wing or to any Police regarding wrong publication of information or cheating or taking money.

1934 and 3/4 of Prize Chit and Money Circulation Scheme Act, 1978 and it is seen that the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate/Special Magistrate, C.B.I/Economic Offences, Jabalpur has passed a reasonable judgment based on the evidence produced by the prosecution.
